While biology and history interest me less, math gives me a sense of order and control that I value in my daily life.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Yes, sometimes I feel anxious because I worry about making mistakes or not understanding complex concepts quickly. My high neuroticism makes me sensitive to pressure, so challenging math problems can trigger stress. However, I push through this anxiety by focusing on my conscientiousness and breaking tasks into manageable steps.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I have used AI tools occasionally for checking my work or getting quick explanations of difficult topics. I prefer traditional methods but appreciate AI as a supplementary resource when needed.

Finally, substitute values and simplify to find the solutions for x.
